name: Central Great Jin and Wanbao Pavilion

pages.title: Great Jin Hub
pages.text: This entry follows region_cards/great_jin_central.json and daily_random_events.json#great_jin_auction_week. The current version reuses existing region and daily-event data without adding an auction UI, Wanbao Pavilion NPCs, a bidding system, a quest loader, or extra network packets.

pages.title: Current Region
pages.text: Central Great Jin is available as great_jin_central with a 1.5 aura multiplier, a Core Formation entry requirement, and great_jin_central_anchor for travel. Its tags are dajin, great_jin_clans, wanbao_pavilion, refinement_halls, cross_region_array, and ancient_artifact.

pages.title: Auction Week Hook
pages.text: Wanbao Pavilion Auction Week appears in great_jin_central as the daily event great_jin_auction_week. It has weight 4, lasts 24000 ticks, and currently provides secret_realm_ticket_hint and rare_loot_hint. Rare formulas, ancient-treasure appraisal, and clan bidding remain future system goals.

pages.title: Related Material
pages.text: The corpus presents Central Great Jin as a high-level economic region for Nascent Soul and Deity Transformation cultivators, associated with great_jin_clans, wanbao_pavilion, refinement_halls, cross_region_array, kunwu_copper, and ancient_artifact_fragment. Runtime currently exposes only the region, tags, and event hints.

pages.title: Planned Content
pages.text: A full Wanbao Pavilion schedule, invitations, bidding UI, lot tables, ancient-treasure appraisal, clan reputation, cross-region array fees, refinement-hall services, and NPCs are not yet implemented. The corresponding native route is projected in the FTB Quests chapter 'Great Jin and Kunwu Mountain'; native progress remains authoritative. This page describes only existing region and event hooks.
